title: MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - PARK) relative to extending the term of City Contract C-144852 with West Valley Homes.
text:
[Council File 26-1438]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - PARK) relative to extending the term of City Contract C-144852 with West Valley Homes.
Recommendation for Council action:
DIRECT and AUTHORIZE the City Clerk to extend the term of City Contract C·144852 with West Valley Homes for continued support for its Recreational Vehicles (RV) Outreach to Home Program, and services in Council District 7 for an extended period from November 1, 2023 to November 1, 2027.
summary: Extends the city's contract with West Valley Homes through November 1, 2027, to continue its recreational vehicle outreach-to-home program in Council District 7.

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 20, 2026); Council action final
